title: Mountain Lightning City
one_sentence: A storm-lit cliff city street where terraces, lanterns, and a lightning rod tower frame a playable Wonder seed.
source_prompt: A vertical mountain city during a thunderstorm, with basalt terraces, switchback stairs, copper storm lanterns, a sky bridge gate, and a lightning rod tower that keeps getting struck.

intent.setting: A compact street corner carved into a high mountain face during an active storm.
intent.emotional_goal: The first view should feel tall, charged, and barely safe.
intent.primary_interaction: Inspect the lightning rod tower and decide whether to open the sky bridge gate.
intent.spatial_logic: A switchback path climbs from the entry landing toward the tower, with terraces and a gate forming the vertical route.

style.lighting: Cold lightning pulses over wet stone while copper lanterns keep the path readable.

required_elements.description: Stacked wall and balcony modules that define the cliff street.
A copper tower that repeatedly draws lightning to the city.
A readable stair route that climbs between the terraces.
A closed gate leading to a narrow bridge lost in storm cloud.
Copper lanterns that mark the safe route through the rain.
Layered cloud silhouettes that sell the height of the city.

camera_intents.purpose: Show the vertical route, storm lanterns, and tower silhouette.
Inspect the charged lightning rod and copper grounding rings.

curiosity_goals: Why does lightning strike the same tower?
What waits beyond the sky bridge gate?
Who keeps the storm lanterns lit?
authoring_notes: Phase 32 JSON-only Wonder example. The committed Scene Graph is contract source data; build and render artifacts are intentionally not checked in.
